user_prompt: In adults with active systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), what is the effect of belimumab at the standard approved dose compared with placebo on achieving at least a 4-point reduction in SELENA-SLEDAI score at 52 weeks?  Extract only the dichotomous ≥4-point reduction in SELENA-SLEDAI at 52 weeks (number of participants achieving the reduction and total participants per arm). For multi-dose trials, use only the belimumab 10 mg/kg arm versus placebo; also include the equivalent approved 200 mg subcutaneous dose when that is the trial's belimumab regimen. Pool using risk ratio (RR). Do not substitute the overall SLE Responder Index (SRI), continuous SELENA-SLEDAI change scores, BILAG, physician global assessment, quality of life, glucocorticoid reduction, adverse events, infections, withdrawals, or mortality. Exclude protocols and non-RCTs.
